headline: Anthropic Abolishes Coding Interviews: AI Takes Over Traditional Roles
summary: Anthropic has eliminated traditional coding interviews, relying on AI's superior performance in solving programming tasks. This shift highlights AI's growing capabilities and its potential to transform hiring practices in tech companies.
whyItMatters: It underscores the increasing automation of technical roles and the need for companies to adapt to new AI-driven hiring processes.

primaryArticle.title: Anthropic Abolishes Coding Interviews: 'Hunger Beats Tenure'

supportingStories.title: Anthropic Shifts Focus to Entrepreneurial Thinking as AI Handles Coding Interviews
